Class Context

java.lang.Object
com.google.adk.agents.ReadonlyContext
com.google.adk.agents.Context
Direct Known Subclasses:
CallbackContext
public class Context extends ReadonlyContext
The context passed to callbacks, tools, and workflow nodes during an invocation.

Agent and model callbacks receive a CallbackContext, and tools and tool callbacks a ToolContext; both extend this class, so a helper that serves both, or a function tool's toolContext parameter, can take a Context. requestConfirmation() requires a function call ID, which only a tool call has, while requireNodeState() and the other workflow node methods require the context of a workflow node.

    • emit

      @Experimental public final void emit(Event event)
      Sends event from this workflow node's FunctionNode body, after the events of earlier calls and before the output. It returns once the run has stored the event and handed it to the run's caller, and any thread of the body may call it. On a Runner that runs work inline, the node needs a FunctionNode.Builder#scheduler that does not, such as Schedulers.io(). The FunctionNode documentation gives the rules for state, threads, events, cancellation and resumes.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if event has an output, or has the ID of an event another emit call still waits on
      IllegalStateException - if no FunctionNode body of this node is running
      CancellationException - if the node is canceled, or the calling thread is interrupted while this call waits; the thread stays interrupted

    • runNode

      @Experimental public final io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Maybe<Object> runNode(Node node, @Nullable Object nodeInput, RunNodeConfig config)
      Returns a Maybe that, when subscribed, runs node as a child of this workflow node and emits the child's output, or completes empty if it has none. Include it in this node's run: when the child waits, the Maybe fails with an internal Error so that this node waits too, which catch (Exception e) lets through but catch (Throwable t) and Rx error handlers such as onErrorResumeNext stop.

      It fails with DynamicNodeFailedException if the child fails; with IllegalStateException if this is not a workflow node's context, if this node's Node.rerunOnResume() is false, or if config delegates an output that this node already has or has delegated; and with IllegalArgumentException if the child's name cannot form a node path.
